events.corrupted-shrine.pages.start.text: You come across a small, rundown shrine on the side of the road.  A shimmering pile of bits lies in the shrine's offering bowl, though the nearest hop is at least a day away.
A band of deserters pop into existence in a burst of static.  They look mightily confused, as if the shrine's idol hadn't warned them.  Unfortunately for you, their blades are already drawn.
events.corrupted-shrine.pages.heal.text: The static noise gently descends upon you and your men, and it feels... Soothing.
events.corrupted-shrine.pages.nope.text: You and your men calmly yet quickly march away from the shrine.
events.corrupted-shrine.pages.loot.text: You brace for retaliation from the shrine, but none comes.
events.whispering-terminal.pages.start.t:
While exploring an abandoned building, you and your men find a decaying computer lab.  Suddenly, one of the screens lights up.

A GIFT, it prints, FOR A FAVOR?
events.whispering-terminal.pages.favor.t: A packet coheres into existence in a burst of static.  You take it.
events.whispering-terminal.pages.flee.te: The monitor stays lit, unfazed by the loss of power.  This is too much for your men, who stampede out of the room.
events.whispering-terminal-collects.page:
You awaken to the sound of your men screaming!  A terminal has popped into existence right in the middle of your camp!

OUR FAVOR IS DUE, it types out, as a pile of golden bits falls to the ground.
It must not understand what a favor actually is.  Weren't *you* supposed to pay *it* back?
Neither you nor your men are foolish enough to take the bits.  Instead, you take the safer option and run.
events.silent-mage.pages.start.text: You come upon a mage, silently meditating by a shrine.
events.silent-mage.pages.decision.text: The mage glares at both you and your band of men.
events.silent-mage.pages.angered.text: The mage signs out a hex and vanishes in a puff of smoke!
events.silent-mage.pages.unamused.text: The mage sighs, less angry than disappointed, and wanders off.
events.silent-mage.pages.happy.text: The mage walks over and sits down amongst your men, a slight smile on his face.
events.silent-mage.pages.quiet.text: You don't talk to the mage, and the mage doesn't talk to you.
events.prodigy.pages.start.text: Your band stay the night with an elderly farmer.  While there, the farmer's grandson talks some of your men into a sparring session.  The boy lacks any sort of training, but you can't help but notice that he seems to have an intuitive grasp of the blade.
events.prodigy.pages.payment.text: The boy darts away to pack his bags before you can even finish your spiel.  His grandfather, though, looks far less enthused.
events.prodigy.pages.join.text: A smile breaks out across the old farmer's face, second only to the one on the boy's.
events.prodigy.pages.cheap.text: The boy, crestfallen, begins to argue with his grandfather.  Better to leave them to it.
events.prodigy.pages.no.text: A band of adventurers is no place for a teenager.
events.mines.pages.start.text: You and your men come across a notice board, with a listing for "able-bodied men who know their way around a pickaxe."  There are no other details.
events.mines.pages.no.text: There's no way that's worth it.
events.mines.pages.accept.text: You all report to the mines.  The foreman hands out the promised pickaxes and grunts, "Start digging."
events.mines.pages.dig1.text: Hours pass.  Nobody has brought you any water.
events.mines.pages.dig2.text: Some of your men are beginning to suffer from heat stroke.
events.mines.pages.dig3.text: A strange gas begins to fill the mines, killing the canaries.
events.mines.pages.done.text: At last the foreman ends the shift.  He collects your pickaxes and presses a small leaden idol into your hands.  It is heavier than it should be.
events.mines.pages.quit.text: There's no way this is worth it.  You all collectively abandon the mines.
events.cheese-tax.pages.start.text: A small dog scurries up to you.  "Kindly pay the cheese tax," it says.
events.cheese-tax.pages.flee.text: "Demon!" one of your men shouts.  All hell breaks loose as your men flee, leaving in their wake a very sad little mutt.
events.cheese-tax.pages.pay.text: "Money can be exchanged for cheese," it says.  The dog flops on its back and lets your men rub its belly.
events.cadre-1.pages.start.text: A young woman is quite literally preaching on a soapbox in the middle of the square of the village you all are staying in.  Her tirade bounces around from landlords to kulaks to imperialism, but none of the peasants seem particularly interested.
events.cadre-1.pages.shoo.text: Your men surround the woman and begin to shuffle her out of the village square.  She makes a scene of it, calling you a class traitor, whatever that means.  The villagers look relieved, however, and one even rewards you with a few bits.
events.cadre-1.pages.listen.text: "Thank you, comrades!" she shouts, before turning back to her proselytizing.  The pamphlet is a dense tome about dialectics which makes your eyes glaze over.
events.cadre-2.pages.start.text:
You come across a village in disarray.  A group of guerillas are locked in a standoff with the village priest.  Leading the guerillas is none other than the young woman who'd been ranting on a soapbox some hops ago.

"Comrades," she addresses you.  "This temple has leached off of the poor for long enough.  Help us burn it down!"

"But it's full of plague victims," pleads the priest.
events.cadre-2.pages.defend.text:
"Sabateur!" hisses the woman.  Before you can engage, she and her posse flee.  The priest thanks you, and presses a few bits into your hand.

"Would that we had more to give, but we can barely pay for medicine."
events.cadre-3.pages.start.text:
Your band arrives at the local county seat and finds a city in chaos.  Squads of men wearing red armbands run rampant, looting anything that looks even vaguely edible.  Or valuable, for that matter.

"Comrades," shouts a familiar voice, "We're evacuating the city before imperial forces besiege us.  Help us!"
events.cadre-3.pages.loot.text: Your men join in with the guerillas.  There's not much to be found that hasn't already been looted, but you do come across an idol in a burned-out hut.
events.cadre-3.pages.help.text: The woman looks at you as if that were the dumbest idea she's ever heard.  She does not, however, stop you.
events.cadre-3.pages.downtown.text: You find a group of bureaucrats in the basement of the city hall; apparently they've in hiding since the guerillas seized control.
events.cadre-3.pages.escape.text: You get the bureaucrats to safety with minimal difficulty.  They reward you handsomely.
events.cadre-3.pages.outskirts.text: You arrive at the outskirts to find an advanced column of government forces.  They don't look particularly friendly.
events.orange-mob.pages.start.text:
Your band comes across a small mob.  They appear to all be short, orange, and musically inclined.  And they appear to be drowning a boy in a river full of...

Wait, chocolate?
events.orange-mob.pages.nope.text: You detour around the singing lynch mob and instead sample the chocolate river.
events.orange-mob.pages.help.text: The little, orange men scatter.  The boy thanks you profusely and offers you a small reward.
events.sector-1-start.pages.start.text: A wizened old man beckons you over.  "This sector is rife with beasts and bandits.  Take something to help yourself."  He gestures at an array of goods that he's splayed on the ground.
events.sector-1-start.pages.end.text: "Farewell," the man says.  In a burst of static, he vanishes.
events.hostage-trio.pages.start.text: You find a small cabal of mages, and they look to have hostages!  Or slaves.  You really can't tell when it comes to mages.
events.hostage-trio.pages.run.text: It's really not any of your business.  Besides, those mages look... Intimidating.
events.burning-tree.pages.start.text: While making camp for the night, a lightning bolt strikes a tree right next to your tent.  The conifer goes up in a burst of flames.  As your men gather around it, you examine the inferno more closely.
events.burning-tree.pages.gold-fire.text: Why, there looks to be a cache of bits hidden in a hollow in the tree's trunk!  A hollow that now looks like a portal to hell, though.
events.burning-tree.pages.gold-immediate: Your men throw themselves into the flames, emerging with both third-degree burns and bulging handfuls of bits.
events.burning-tree.pages.gold-caution.t: Come the morning, you and your men pick through the ashes. You find a few bits, but you find the molten remnants of far more.
events.burning-tree.pages.chase-good.tex: You and your men run in the direction that the fire points.  Soon, you find yourself at the mouth of a cave--and it's filled with packets!
events.burning-tree.pages.chase-bad.text: You and your men run in the direction that the fire points.  Soon, you find yourself in a clearing absolutely teeming with rats!
events.quiet.pages.start.text: The road on which you're traveling forks in twain, with a sign labeling each path.  One lists the name of the provincial capital; the other simply says, "The Quiet Glade."
events.quiet.pages.no-fun.text: You continue on your way, like the serious band of adventurers that you are.
events.quiet.pages.quiet1.text:
After half a day's march, you come upon the promised glade.

It's quiet.
events.quiet.pages.quiet3.text: So quiet that your internal monologue begins to...
events.quiet.pages.loud.text:
"Shut up!" shrieks the gnome.  "This is the Quiet Glade!"

The gnome silently heals a few of your men, and silently takes some bits in exchange.  Silently.
events.quiet.pages.quiet6.text: A daemon quietly appears in the midst of your men.
events.pitcher-plant.pages.start.text:
While hacking your way through a particularly dense thicket, you and your men stumble across a giant pitcher plant, with a pair of legs sticking out of its maw.

"Is somebody there?" a voice, presumably attached to the legs, asks.  "Would you mind helping me out of here?  It's going to take me hours, otherwise."
events.pitcher-plant.pages.save.text:
Your men cut the hapless adventurer out with ease.

"Much obliged," he says.  He then hands you a pulpy, green blob.  "This secretes the plant's digestive enzymes.  I was trying to harvest it; the locals say it's a delicacy."

Or maybe they were trying to get him killed.  Before you can point this out, though, the adventurer jogs off.
events.pitcher-plant.pages.thievery.text:
In a mad rush, your men climb up the side of the plant and begin systematically divesting the hapless adventurer of his belongings.

"Hey, now," he protests, "That's not very sporting!"

Unfortunately, you don't find much on his person.
events.fox-hunt.pages.start.text:
Absolute carnage bars the road ahead, as a party of hunters appears locked in a pitched battle with a pack of foxes!

As you and your men contemplate what to do, a sly fox spirit emerges from the undergrowth and sidles up to you.  "For a small fee, I can lead you around this melee," she offers.
events.fox-hunt.pages.guide.text: You hand a few bits over and fall in line behind the fox spirit, as she leads you on a winding path through the brush.
events.fox-hunt.pages.shrine.text: After twenty minutes of hiking, the fox spirit deposits you and your men onto the road.  To the side is a small shrine.
events.fox-hunt.pages.heal.text: You toss a few more bits away, and they land in the shrine's offering bowl.  A warm, calming aura immediately washes over your men.
events.fox-hunt.pages.advance.text: You turn to give your thanks to the fox spirit, only to find that she's vanished.
events.corrupted-shrine.pages.heal.choic: What a pleasant turn of events!
events.whispering-terminal.pages.favor.c: What could it want in return?
events.whispering-terminal.pages.flee.ch: It's not a retreat!  We're advancing backwards.
events.whispering-terminal-collects.page: Surely it must be a trap!
Discretion is the better part of valor, isn't it?
events.silent-mage.pages.unamused.choice: At least he didn't attack us
events.prodigy.pages.payment.choices.per: Perhaps some bits will cheer him up
events.cadre-1.pages.start.choices.best-: Best put a stop to this now
events.cadre-1.pages.listen.choices.can-: Can the villagers even read this?
What's that glimmer inside the trunk?
The flames are going against the wind!
events.burning-tree.pages.gold-fire.choi: Let's see what's left after the fire burns down.
events.quiet.pages.start.choices.move-on: The Quiet Glade?  That sounds mysterious!
Maybe we can use it to poison our blades.
events.pitcher-plant.pages.thievery.choi: Aren't adventurers supposed to be rich?
